Treatment summary
Patient presented following a low-speed head-on collision with neck pain, stiffness, and headaches radiating from the base of the
skull. The reported injury is consistent with the mechanism of this type of crash. Care consisted of 19 visits including manual
therapy, active range-of-motion exercises, and home stretching instructions. The course followed a typical progression, with visit
frequency tapering as symptoms eased and the patient reported gradual improvement. Nearly all of the documented findings rest
on the patient's own description of pain and limitation; cervical imaging and standard orthopedic and neurological examination
tests were within normal limits. The patient reported a minor strain to the same region several years ago, which resolved
completely without ongoing care. Two similar charges entered on the same day are currently under review for accuracy.
Prognosis is favorable with continued home exercise and as-needed follow-up.

  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.

"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
